entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Bits 5 to 8 of the first octet of every EPS Session Management (ESM) message contain the EPS bearer identity. It is used to identify a message flow.

entities.name: ESM message
entities.description: EPS Session Management message that contains the EPS bearer identity in bits 5 to 8 of its first octet.

entities.name: MME
entities.description: Mobility Management Entity that selects EPS bearer identity values and handles bearer context management.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that may not support signalling for maximum 15 EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: Maximum 15 EPS bearer contexts not supported
entities.description: Condition where UE or MME or both do not support signalling for maximum 15 EPS bearer contexts.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity range 5 to 15
entities.description: Value range from which MME selects EPS bearer identity when maximum 15 EPS bearer contexts are not supported.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity value 0
entities.description: Value 0 indicates no EPS bearer identity is assigned, used when maximum 15 EPS bearer contexts are not supported.

relations.description: Every ESM message contains the EPS bearer identity in bits 5-8 of its first octet.
When maximum 15 EPS bearer contexts are not supported, MME selects EPS bearer identity from range 5 to 15.
When maximum 15 EPS bearer contexts are not supported, MME may select value 0 to indicate no EPS bearer identity assigned.
MME behavior is guarded by the condition of whether maximum 15 EPS bearer contexts are supported.
UE capability regarding maximum 15 EPS bearer contexts guards the condition.
